title: Reading Comprehension - First Paragraph!
description: You can READ FRENCH! This entire paragraph uses only words you've learned. Comprehension test!
can_do: Read and understand a complete French paragraph
Recognize sentence patterns using all your vocabulary
Comprehend French stories and basic conversations

passage.fr: Bonjour ! Je suis Paul. Je suis un homme. J'ai un chat et un chien aussi.
passage.en: Hello! I am Paul. I am a man. I have a cat and a dog too.

passage.fr: Paul, un chat et un chien.
passage.en: Paul, a cat and a dog.

img.alt: Paul, in a red jacket, stands in front of a village house with an orange cat and a cream dog.

passage.fr: Tu es Marie. Tu es une femme. Tu as une maison et une voiture. La maison est très bonne !
passage.en: You are Marie. You are a woman. You have a house and a car. The house is very good!

passage.fr: Marie, la maison et la voiture.
passage.en: Marie, the house and the car.

img.alt: Marie, in a blue dress, beside her yellow car and her white house with blue shutters.

passage.fr: Tu as un ami. Il a des livres. J'ai une amie aussi. Elle a des chats et des livres aussi.
passage.en: You have a friend. He has books. I have a friend too. She has cats and books too.

passage.fr: Les amis ont des livres et des chats.
passage.en: The friends have books and cats.

img.alt: A blond man reads beside a stack of books; a red-haired woman reads with two cats asleep at her feet.

passage.fr: Nous sommes les amis. Nous avons des enfants et des chiens. Les chiens sont très bons, mais les chats sont bons aussi.
passage.en: We are the friends. We have children and dogs. The dogs are very good, but the cats are good too.

passage.fr: Les amis, les enfants, les chiens et le chat.
passage.en: The friends, the children, the dogs and the cat.

img.alt: The four friends sit on the grass with two children, two dogs and a cat, bicycles behind them.

passage.fr: C'est un très bon jour ! Nous sommes très bons.
passage.en: It's a very good day! We are very good.

img.alt: Paul and Marie wave goodbye at the garden gate under a yellow sun, a dog sitting beside them.

items.question: What animals does Paul have?
accept: il a un chat et un chien
il a un chien et un chat

mistakes.feedback: Paul has more than just a cat - read further!
Paul has more than just a dog - he also has a cat!

items.question: What does Marie have?
accept: elle a une maison et une voiture
elle a une voiture et une maison
items.hint: Look for {tu as ___} - she has two things

items.question: What does Paul's male friend have?
What does Paul's female friend have?
items.hint: Look for {elle a ___} - she has two things connected by {et}

items.question: What do {nous} (we) have?
accept: ils ont des enfants et des chiens
ils ont des chiens et des enfants
items.hint: Fourth paragraph - {nous avons ___} - we have two things

items.question: What word intensifies {bon} in the phrase about the day?

mistakes.feedback: That's the adjective. What word comes BEFORE 'bon'?

items.question: Which connector word is used to contrast dogs and cats?
items.cue: The dogs are good, ___ the cats are good too
items.hint: Look for the word showing contrast: {très bon, ___ les chats}

mistakes.feedback: That means 'and'. Look for the word meaning 'but'
That means 'also/too', not the connector showing contrast
